blocks.heading: Illustrated fund by year
blocks.code:
<svg id="c" width="100%" height="200" role="img" aria-label="Illustrated fund by year, low, mid and high"></svg>
<style>svg text{font:12px var(--font,system-ui,sans-serif);fill:var(--ink-2)}.l{fill:none;stroke-width:2}.k{font-weight:600}</style>
<script>
braindog.on(function (d) {
  var f = d.columns.map(function (c) { return c.field; });
  var rows = d.rows.map(function (r) { return r.fields; }).filter(function (r) { return r.year && r.mid; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.year - b.year; });
  var svg = document.getElementById('c');
  var out = '';
  svg.innerHTML = '';
  if (rows.length < 2) return;
  var W = svg.clientWidth || 600, H = 200, L = 8, R = 56, T = 12, B = 22;
  var val = function (m) { return m && typeof m.amount === 'number' ? m.amount : null; };
  var all = [];
  rows.forEach(function (r) { ['low', 'mid', 'high'].forEach(function (k) { var v = val(r[k]); if (v !== null) all.push(v); }); });
  var lo = Math.min.apply(null, all), hi = Math.max.apply(null, all);
  if (hi === lo) hi = lo + 1;
  var y0 = rows[0].year, y1 = rows[rows.length - 1].year;
  var x = function (y) { return L + ((y - y0) / Math.max(1, y1 - y0)) * (W - L - R); };
  var y = function (v) { return T + (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo)) * (H - T - B); };
  var add = function (name, attrs, text) { var a = ''; for (var k in attrs) a += ' ' + k + '="' + attrs[k] + '"'; out += '<' + name + a + '>' + (text || '') + '</' + name + '>'; };
  [['low', 'Low', 'var(--ink-3)'], ['mid', 'Mid', 'var(--ink)'], ['high', 'High', 'var(--good)']].forEach(function (s) {
    var pts = rows.filter(function (r) { return val(r[s[0]]) !== null; });
    add('polyline', { 'class': 'l', stroke: s[2], points: pts.map(function (r) { return x(r.year) + ',' + y(val(r[s[0]])); }).join(' ') });
    var last = pts[pts.length - 1];
    add('text', { x: x(last.year) + 6, y: y(val(last[s[0]])) + 4, 'class': 'k' }, s[1]);
  });
  add('text', { x: L, y: H - 6 }, String(y0));
  add('text', { x: W - R, y: H - 6, 'text-anchor': 'end' }, String(y1));
  svg.innerHTML = out;
});
</script>
